name: check-vat-registration-south-africa
description: Determine whether a South African business must or may register for VAT under the post-Budget-2026 thresholds, and estimate a simple VAT payable/refund position at 15%.
requires_human_steps: Complete the actual VAT registration on SARS eFiling or at a SARS branch
Confirm taxable-supply classification (exempt / zero-rated) with a registered tax practitioner
Prepare actual VAT201 returns from full records - the position tool is an estimate only
rule_basis: VAT registration tests per SARS: compulsory above R2.3m taxable supplies in any consecutive 12 months, voluntary above R120,000 (both effective 1 April 2026, Budget 2026); VAT rate 15% (2025 proposed increases reversed 24 April 2025)
